correctness.rationale: Kummer-borrow transition checked independently against Pascal rows. State dimension is alpha+(alpha-1). Reachable states from zero prefixes and suffix p-1 digit span all of W. Two explicit triangular observation families separate every U and V coefficient. The resulting kernel Hankel rank is exactly 2alpha-1, including alpha=1; 18 exact rational finite cases and direct binomial counts agree. No finite extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The 2010 source explicitly states the exact rational rank 2alpha-1 as an open problem. The 2017 polynomial matrix construction supplies a spanning upper bound but not a matching lower bound. Full-text inspection of that paper and the 2016 generating-function work found no exact minimality proof; public mathematical-record searches and comparison with other mathematical claims found no equivalent statement. The new reachable/observable lower-bound argument is the substantive advance, subject to residual historical priority risk.
residual_risks: Not every paper on p-regular sequences, minimal automata or Pascal-row statistics has been inspected; equivalent hidden coverage remains possible.
Barat–Grabner (2001) original full text was not materially inspected, though later authors characterize its results as subword polynomial and asymptotic distribution.
The rank is over rational scalars, not a claim about automata over finite fields or deterministic-state minimality.
